title: Senior Identity Governance Specialist - Bilingual

Application Onboarding: Demonstrated experience onboarding applications into Saviynt. Lifecycle & Directory Integration: Experience integrating Saviynt with directories and identity sources (e.g., Active Directory, Azure AD, HR systems, ERP, AWS). Upgrades & Maintenance: Proven experience performing IGA platform upgrades and managing version changes. Technical & Development Skills Coding & Scripting: Strong development/coding experience, including Java / Groovy scripting and PowerShell. Integration Mechanisms: Practical experience with REST‑based integrations, ITSM integrations, rules, workflows, and APIs. Problem Solving: Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Functional IAM Knowledge Foundational Concepts: Solid understanding of IAM/IGA concepts, specifically identity lifecycle management, RBAC / ABAC, access certifications, and Segregation of Duties (SoD). Language & Communication Language Proficiency: Bilingual capabilities (Español/Ingles or Português/Ingles). Ideal Qualifications (Nice-to-Have) Certifications Product Specific: Saviynt certifications (IGA Professional, Advanced, or Implementation certifications). Industry Standards: CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), or CGRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance Certification). Cloud & Ecosystem Familiarity Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Ecosystem Tools: Familiarity with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow. title: Guest Experience Manager

This role focuses on brand implementation, experiential elements, FIFA Club concept (including F&B), and curated guest touchpoints such as gifts and in‑hotel experiences. Collaborate with relevant functional areas to ensure alignment of VIP Hotel guest experience delivery (e.g. Accommodation, Protocol, Transport, Branding). Establish clear lines of communication and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and involved parties. Develop training concepts and deliver training sessions for all relevant suppliers, their service staff, and volunteers, focusing on excellence and ‘wow’ customer service. Attend site visits and inspections. Your Profile Education Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business Management, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Marketing & Communications, or a related field. Specialization in hospitality, event management, or experience design is an advantage. Experience 5+ years of proven experience in developing and delivering premium VIP guest experience concepts and operations, ideally within hotel environments, hospitality settings, or large‑scale events. Extensive experience in concept development and implementation of guest experience elements, including branding, scenography, F&B concepts, and curated guest touchpoints. Experience in designing and delivering premium hospitality environments (e.g. lounges, clubs, VIP spaces, or hotel‑based experiences). Proven experience in managing and coordinating external agencies and suppliers for experience delivery (e.g. production, branding, F&B, experiential agencies). Hands‑on experience in implementing on‑site guest experience concepts, including setup, testing, and operational delivery. Experience working in cross‑functional environments, coordinating with hospitality, accommodation, and operational stakeholders. Skills & Competencies Fluent Portuguese and English (spoken and written) with excellent communication skills. Strong attention to detail with the ability to ensure high‑quality delivery of premium guest experience standards. Ability to translate conceptual ideas into operational execution, ensuring consistency between design and on‑site delivery. Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to anticipate, manage, and resolve complex situations in fast‑paced environments. Proven ability to manage and steer multiple external suppliers and agencies to deliver against defined concepts and timelines. Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder management skills across cross‑functional teams. Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously. High level of adaptability and resilience in dynamic, high‑pressure event environments. Solid understanding of premium hospitality environments and guest expectations. Advanced skills in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint; Project or similar tools is an advantage). Certifications & Requirements Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage. Additional certifications in hospitality, event management, or experience design are considered a plus. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our work demands mastery across electronics, hydraulics, mechanics, systems, and control to create products that survive and perform in harsh, high-temperature, high-load downhole conditions. We are seeking a mechanical technician with 3+ years' experience in lab and field testing of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for downhole drilling systems, including assembly, prototyping, operating, and debugging the associated test equipment. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. The opportunity for you You will own the hands‑on assembly, testing, and maintenance of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for our downhole drilling systems — running functional and performance tests in the lab and supporting prototype bring‑up, qualification campaigns, and operational deployments in the field. You will work alongside mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers, capturing test data and feeding it back into design and reliability improvements. Responsibilities Conduct functional tests, performance evaluations, and calibrations on mechanical and electromechanical equipment to ensure compliance with quality standards and manufacturer specifications. Set up and operate test equipment — pressure and temperature test rigs, hydraulic test benches, torque tools, dimensional metrology (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and data acquisition systems — to run characterization, qualification, and acceptance testing. Diagnose and repair mechanical and hydraulic failures at the component and assembly level, including disassembly, inspection, replacement of worn or damaged parts, and rework of seals, fasteners, and fittings. Support prototype bring‑up and design iterations by capturing test data, flagging anomalies, and feeding observations back to mechanical and systems engineers. Assembly, Field Support & Documentation Assemble, disassemble, inspect, and perform preventative maintenance on mechanical and hydraulic equipment (downhole tools, actuators, drillstring components, pumps, valves, and associated test fixtures) according to technical specifications and procedures. Maintain accurate service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation, and generate clear reports on work performed and equipment status. Provide hands‑on support to field representatives and drilling crews during qualification campaigns and deployments, and travel to field locations when required. Coordinate with other technicians, engineers, and field representatives to resolve complex issues, support failure analysis, and ensure seamless equipment deployment. Help maintain an organized work environment and manage inventory of electronic components, parts, and supplies. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture, adhere to HSE regulations and quality procedures, and help maintain a safe, organized work environment (5S, housekeeping, waste segregation). What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 3+ years of experience working with mechanical and hydraulic equipment, preferably in an industrial or oilfield environment. Technical school certificate in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Proficiency with mechanical and hydraulic test equipment (pressure and temperature rigs, torque tools, hydraulic benches), dimensional metrology instruments (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and hand and power tools. Skilled in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including torque‑controlled fastening, seal and o‑ring installation, and alignment of rotating and reciprocating components. Ability to read, understand, and interpret technical manuals, drawings, schematics, blueprints, and engineering instructions. Experience troubleshooting and repairing mechanical and hydraulic equipment and generating clear service and calibration reports. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Basic computer literacy and familiarity with data acquisition and diagnostic software, plus strong problem‑solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills. Customer Interface & Cross‑Functional Collaboration Experience working alongside engineers, field representatives, and drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and on‑site troubleshooting. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to capture lab and field test observations as clear, actionable feedback for engineering. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence High attention to detail and discipline in service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation. Ability to work independently or as part of a team, executing assigned tasks reliably against schedule and procedures. Contributes to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement based on test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast‑moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands‑on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable on the shop floor, in the lab, and at field locations as required, including travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping refine them as systems and processes mature. Adaptable and resilient in early‑stage and transitioning‑to‑commercial technology environments. Open to giving and receiving constructive feedback that improves equipment performance and reliability. Nice to have Associate degree or higher in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related discipline. Experience with downhole tools, drillstring components, or other oilfield mechanical equipment. Familiarity with calibration management systems and qualification testing standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high‑temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra‑deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: SIMULATION ENGINEER - JUNIOR
description: Overview GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. We are looking for a Junior Simulation Engineer to help develop, run, and improve simulation models for mechanical, hydraulic, thermal, and downhole drilling systems. You will work with experienced engineers, receive technical guidance, and take responsibility for clearly scoped modeling, analysis, scripting, and reporting tasks. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro city - RJ. The opportunity for you You will work closely with engineers across simulation, mechanical design, testing, and product development. The role includes mentorship and technical review, but also expects you to manage assigned tasks, document assumptions, communicate blockers early, and turn analysis results into clear next steps. Responsibilities Modeling & Simulation Build and update simulation models using tools such as MATLAB, Simulink, and Simscape. Model physical systems across mechanical, hydraulic, and thermal domains under guidance from senior engineers. Apply numerical methods to help predict system behavior and compare model outputs against expected results. Prepare, run, and review finite element or fluid dynamics simulations using tools such as Ansys or OpenFOAM. Develop scripts and small tools for simulation workflows, data processing, and result visualization. Analyze simulation outputs and summarize findings in clear technical reports. Read engineering drawings, schematics, and requirements to translate physical systems into model inputs and assumptions. Collaborate with engineers across disciplines on product development, testing, and failure analysis. Follow health, safety, environmental, and quality procedures. What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge Degree, advanced coursework, or equivalent practical experience in mechanical, mechatronics, aerospace, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related technical field. Academic, internship, lab, or project experience with simulation, numerical methods, physics-based modeling, or engineering analysis. Basic understanding of mechanics, fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, system modeling, or numerical methods. Programming ability in Python and C++ for engineering scripts, simulation workflows, and data processing. Ability to read technical documentation, schematics, and engineering instructions. Clear written and verbal communication for collaboration and technical reporting. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Analytical thinking, curiosity, and comfort asking for guidance when information is incomplete. Customer Interface & Cross-Functional Collaboration Willingness to engage with engineering teams, test personnel, and — under guidance — customer-facing activities to support testing and troubleshooting. Clear communication skills, with the ability to capture test observations and translate them into structured notes and engineering feedback. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence Attention to detail and a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and following configuration control practices. Ability to take ownership of clearly scoped tasks and see them through from preparation to close-out, asking for guidance when needed. Eagerness to contribute to root cause analysis and corrective actions, learning from test and field results. Comfort working in fast-moving, technically challenging environments while maintaining rigor in your work. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands-on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable working on the shop floor, in test environments, and in the field as required, including occasional travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures and an open mindset as systems and processes mature. Adaptable and resilient, with an interest in early-stage and transitioning-to-commercial technology environments. Nice to have Experience with MATLAB, Simulink, or Simscape. Exposure to Ansys, OpenFOAM, finite element analysis, or computational fluid dynamics. Experience validating model results against tests, hand calculations, or expected system behavior. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high-temperature downhole environments. What we offer Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra-deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Staff Software Engineer
description: Staff Software Engineer – Lending Foundations About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and beyond – and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. We combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. The Global Lending Foundations team, within our Global Lending BU, is building the platform that fundamentally changes how we design, build, and roll out lending decisions across new geographies. Our mission is to create the tools and evolve the architecture that make it dramatically easier to launch lending products in new countries, with high business impact and direct exposure to Nu’s global expansion. As a Staff Software Engineer – Lending Foundations , you will be a senior technical leader in this platform layer: defining the long-horizon technical direction for how Lending platforms scale across countries, products, and partners, and shaping how every future lending product is built across Brazil, the US, Mexico, Colombia and future markets. You will operate at platform scale – building shared infrastructure that other teams depend on for years – while working in a highly engaged, multi-level engineering group (IC7–IC4) and partnering closely with product and business leaders. You’ll be responsible for Owning the architectural vision for Lending Foundations: Define and evolve the platform architecture that underpins lending products across countries, products, and partners, making decisions that outlast individual cycles. Designing and scaling shared platform capabilities: Build core services, decisioning primitives and integration patterns that multiple lending teams rely on, balancing flexibility with consistency and long‑term maintainability. Leading cross‑team architectural initiatives: Drive alignment on hard technical choices across engineering squads and stakeholders, bringing clarity where the path forward is genuinely unclear and ensuring coherent evolution of the Lending platform layer. Evolving event‑oriented architectures: Apply and refine CQRS and event‑driven patterns across the platform, making thoughtful trade‑offs when building shared infrastructure that must work across geographies and regulatory contexts. Partnering with product and business leadership: Work closely with the Global Lending BU to translate business goals and expansion plans into platform capabilities and roadmaps, ensuring high, measurable impact on global lending expansion. Multiplying senior engineering talent: Mentor senior engineers, help them grow toward Staff level, and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, technical guidance, and clear written and verbal communication. We are looking for a person who has Required Extensive experience as a senior / staff‑level engineer designing and evolving complex distributed systems or platform layers that serve multiple product teams. Deep experience with event‑oriented architectures (e.g., CQRS, event sourcing, streaming) and clear views on the trade‑offs of building shared infrastructure that other teams will depend on for years. Strong background in at least one functional or JVM‑based stack ; Proven track record owning architectural vision for large domains or platforms, and bringing clarity and direction in spaces where requirements and constraints are evolving. Demonstrated ability to drive alignment on hard architectural decisions across multiple squads and stakeholders, including senior engineers and technical leaders. Experience acting as a platform‑oriented engineer , where primary customers are other engineering and product teams, and your work directly shapes what they can ship and how fast. Strong communication skills – able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences, and to influence decisions at multiple levels. Nice to have Experience in lending, credit, or financial services platforms. Experience working in multi‑country or global product environments. Prior responsibility for migration or re‑platforming initiatives at scale. title: ENGENHEIRO(A) DE NOVOS NEGÓCIOS I
description: Somos formados por pessoas de diferentes idades e experiências profissionais. A Celeo apoia diversos projetos de cultura, educação, bem-estar, saúde, ações de cidadania, solidariedade, entre outros com o compromisso com a sociedade e acreditando que juntos formamos um time mais forte. Reconhecemos a importância das pessoas para o nosso negócio e buscamos diariamente a construção de ambientes propícios ao desenvolvimento, segurança e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, terceiros e prestadores de serviços, e ainda, da população próxima aos nossos empreendimentos, nos tornando um ótimo lugar para trabalhar todos os dias. Apoiar na estruturação do valor do investimento (CAPEX e OPEX), realizando análise crítica e cronogramas de desembolso, sob supervisão. Conduzir estudos de inteligência de mercado para avaliar a competitividade e benchmarking setorial. Interpretação de Editais, referências técnicas e contratos de concessão, mapeando riscos regulatórios ou impactos na viabilidade dos projetos conforme documentações técnicas. Apoiar nas análises de parcerias estratégicas, através das negociações técnicas/comerciais, sob supervisão. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Teya Senior Machine Learning Engineer you will build models and decision systems that turn Teya's data into better outcomes for our customers and our business. You will work in the AI Research & Development team partnering with engineers, product managers, and domain experts to take problems from framing through model development and into reliable, monitored production systems. Responsibilities Frame ambiguous business problems as well-posed modeling, inference, or optimization tasks, and choose methods that fit the data and the decision. Design, build, validate, and deploy predictive and decisioning models across areas such as fraud and risk monitoring, customer onboarding and due diligence, pricing, and customer lifetime value. Run rigorous experiments and causal analyses, including A/B testing, uplift modeling, and offline evaluation, to measure whether models actually move the outcomes that matter. Engineer features and build the data pipelines that feed training and serving, with attention to leakage, reproducibility, and data quality. Productionise models with strong attention to validation, backtesting, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining, so performance holds up after launch. Work closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to identify where modeling creates value and to integrate models into products and operational workflows. Apply optimization and operations research methods where decisions, not just predictions, are the goal. Contribute to modeling standards, evaluation practices, and reusable tooling across the team. Stay current with developments in machine learning and statistics, and apply new methods where they earn their place. Requirements Strong foundations in statistics and machine learning, with the judgment to match methods to problems. Proficiency in Python and its data and ML ecosystem (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy), and strong SQL. Hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in production, not only in notebooks. Solid command of supervised and unsupervised learning, including methods such as gradient boosting, regularised regression, and clustering, with a clear understanding of model evaluation and overfitting. Experience with experimentation and inference, including A/B testing and the basics of causal estimation. Experience with cloud platforms and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, APIs, monitoring, infrastructure as code). Strong software engineering fundamentals including testing, reproducibility, and maintainability. Ability to communicate quantitative findings and their business implications clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Nice to have Experience building models in regulated industries such as payments, fintech, banking, risk, compliance, or fraud prevention. Experience with use cases such as: Fraud detection and anomaly detection Credit and onboarding risk decisioning Pricing and customer lifetime value modeling Churn and propensity modeling Forecasting and time series Recommendation and personalisation Background in operations research, mathematical programming, or stochastic optimization. Knowledge of MLOps, model lifecycle management, feature stores, monitoring, and governance. Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow where the problem warrants them. Familiarity with data engineering concepts, analytics platforms, and experimentation frameworks. Contributions to the ML or statistics community through open source, research, or technical writing. Equal Opportunity Employer Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know – we are committed to ensuring a fair and accessible experience. #J-18808-Ljbffr

We also ensure that our systems are self‑healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state‑of‑the‑art languages like Scala and Go, data technologies like Kafka and Aerospike, and agile development practices. Most importantly, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of the Back End Engineering team. Qualifications Extremely proficient in at least one programming language (Java, Scala, C#). Strong experience in systems architecture – particularly in complex, scalable, and fault‑tolerant distributed systems. Demonstrable experience as a system owner with operational responsibility. Proficient in lower‑level engineering (garbage collection, context switching, threading). Experience with DevOps culture – agility, leanness, automation, CI/CD. Good understanding of application security. Passionate about technology and the Internet. Have worked in a successful agile development team. Have run engineering teams before with five or more direct reports. Able to operate autonomously: make decisions, set KPIs, with a strong sense of ownership. Practice data‑driven decision making. Nice to Have Proficiency in more than one programming language. title: Jr Project Manager

Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well‑being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Kyndryl Project Managers oversee the delivery of major projects within scope, schedule, and budget. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day. As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail‑oriented calendar. You’ll be constructing detailed project plans, managing teams, and leading meetings, status calls, and planning and cadence meetings. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling. But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. Bottom line: You need to like interactions with other people and know how to be kind and empathetic but also assertive — and handle customer change requests with diplomacy. You’re going to be meeting a lot of people, networking, and forging relationships. Our “one team with the customer” concept means you’ll develop especially strong partnerships with the client and elsewhere. Some projects or clients even involve “embedding” with the client at their location. This puts more visibility on you personally, but it also gives you more opportunity to add value to the relationship. It’s a great way to hone your service and people skills, and it lays the groundwork for career growth both laterally and vertically. Your Future at Kyndryl Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well‑rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non‑technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a senior project manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of PM roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer‑focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical And Professional Experience SCRUM or Project Management skills Organization and planning skills Bachelor's degree in IT, Networking, or Business Administration MBA or postgraduate degree in project management Availability for travel Preferred Technical And Professional Experience Advanced English MS Project or other Project Management software Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid‑friendly culture that supports your well‑being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in‑demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting‑edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands‑on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. title: Analista Sênior de Logística - Mercado Envios
description: No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito! Em um mundo em constante evolução, nossa capacidade para entregar rapidamente os produtos que são comprados através do Mercado Livre tornou-se um requisito para competir. Temos um desafio para as pessoas que: Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites. Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação. Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros. A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas. Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão. Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe. Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por: Atuar de forma analítica no processo de recebimento, processamento e expedição, dentro da operação dedicada para mercadorias pesadas e volumosas, a fim de atuar no planejamento, programação e acompanhamento hora a hora de performance e níveis de serviços. Desenvolver análises de indicadores de desempenho logístico, propondo ações corretivas e melhorias nos processos. Também realiza análise de custos logísticos, identificando oportunidades para redução de despesas e ganhos de eficiência, além de utilizar sistemas de gerenciamento para controles, análises e consolidação de informações críticas das operações. Elaborar procedimentos e fluxos operacionais, bem como atualizá-los para promover a padronização e otimização das atividades logísticas. Também garantir o cumprimento de normas, políticas internas e legislações aplicáveis às atividades de armazenagem, transporte e segurança. Apoiar na gestão de relacionamento com transportadoras e operadores logísticos, monitorando níveis de serviço e performance. Participar de projetos de implantação e melhorias, como revisões de layout, implementação de processos Lean, automações ou novas tecnologias. Também atua como referência técnica, apoiando o treinamento e desenvolvimento dos demais membros da equipe, assim como colaborar para a integração entre áreas correlacionadas, como comercial, compras, customer service e fiscal, assegurando o fluxo logístico. Requisitos Contar com ensino superior completo em Logística, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Ter experiência consolidada em operações logísticas envolvendo armazenagem e transportes, em setores como e-commerce, varejo ou indústria. É um diferencial ter atuado com foco em mercadorias pesadas e volumosas. Também contar com sólidos conhecimentos de indicadores, projetos de melhoria e ferramentas de gestão logística como sistemas TMS, WMS, ERP e IA. Ser usuário/a com conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de análise, como Excel ou Google Sheets, assim como ter vivência com Tableau, Power BI e ferramentas de visualização de dados. Também ter domínio de ferramentas de qualidade e melhoria como 5S, Kaizen, 5 Porquês, PDCA. Estar disponível para atuação presencial na BARRA - RJ, com flexibilidade de horário para atuação em turnos, sendo T1, T2 ou T3 (operação 24h) e escala 5x2. Nós lhe propomos Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo. Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores. Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas. Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie! #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Venue Operations Assistant Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
description: Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Location: Brazil Overview FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Working closely with FIFA functional areas, venue teams, stadiums and host city authorities and service providers, the role is responsible for coordinating operational activities, monitoring project progress, supporting venue readiness, and ensuring that venue plans are implemented efficiently and in compliance with FIFA Hosting Requirements. The Venue Operations Assistant Manager plays a key role in facilitating communication across stakeholders, tracking operational deliverables, supporting reporting processes, meetings and inspections, and contributing to the successful delivery of match days and non-match day activities. The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting one Venue Operations Assistant Manager for each host city: Belo Horizonte - Estádio Mineirão Brasília - Estádio Nacional Fortaleza - Arena Castelão Porto Alegre - Estádio Beira-Rio Recife - Arena de Pernambuco Rio de Janeiro - Estádio do Maracanã Salvador - Arena Fonte Nova São Paulo - Arena Itaquera Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently. Responsibilities Support the Venue Operations Manager in the planning and operational delivery of the venue activities. Coordinate day-to-day operational planning across FIFA functional areas and local stakeholders. Monitor the implementation of venue operational plans and follow up on action items and deadlines. Assist in integrating functional area requirements into the overall venue operational plan. Coordinate meetings, workshops and venue operational briefings with internal and external stakeholders. Support venue inspections, site visits, and stadium readiness activities. Track venue issues, risks and mitigation actions, escalating matters to the Venue Operations Manager when appropriate. Maintain operational documentation, reports, meeting minutes, and planning tools. Support to coordinate Operational Maps review (BIM360) follow-up activities resulting from inspections and site visits. Support the planning and delivery of official test events and operational exercises. Assist in coordinating venue service providers and local authorities during planning and event-time operations. Support budget tracking, procurement follow-up and operational reporting as requested by the Venue Operations Manager. Contribute to knowledge management activities, operational debriefs and lessons learned documentation. Support match day and non-match day operations, ensuring timely communication and coordination across all stakeholders. Coordinate the preparation, maintenance and distribution of daily operational documentation, including the Daily Run Sheet, operational schedules, daily reports and other venue operational documents. Coordinate venue daily operational meetings, ensuring agendas, documentation, action tracking and follow-up with all relevant stakeholders. Coordinate the planning and delivery of venue team onboarding, inductions and operational training sessions to ensure all personnel are prepared for venue operations. Liaise with the Stadium Authority core team to ensure the timely delivery of all core stadium services and operational requirements, maintaining close coordination throughout the planning and operational phases. Act as a key operational focal point during match days, proactively resolving operational issues on the ground while liaising with and responding to the Venue Operations Centre (VOC), ensuring timely communication, issue escalation and coordinated implementation of solutions. Perform other operational duties as assigned by the Venue Operations Manager. Profile Education University degree in an appropriate field (or equivalent professional experience). Experience Strong experience in venue operations, event management, sports venues or large-scale international events. Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders in complex operational environments. Strong organizational and project coordination skills. Experience supporting operational planning and event delivery. Ability to work under pressure while managing multiple priorities. Experience with reporting, planning tools and operational documentation. Experience working with public authorities, venue operators or service providers is considered an advantage. Skills & Competencies. Excellent organizational and coordination skills. Strong communication and interpersonal abilities. Proactive and solution-oriented mindset. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow through on deliverables. Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary and multicultural teams. Good problem-solving and decision-support skills. Ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment. Adaptability, resilience and flexibility. Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Commitment to delivering operational excellence. Certifications & Requirements Right to work in Brazil Fluent in English (spoken and written) Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) Strong administrative and IT skills, including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint) and Monday.com. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Open Call: Itinera Arte International Artist Residency Program — Expanded Field
description: Open Call: Itinera Arte International Artist Residency Program — Expanded Field Performance Art, Film, Art, Photography, Others Description Entitled Expanded Field, the 3rd cycle of Itinera Arte's International Artist Residency Program proposes a critical and sensitive investigation into practices that take shape at the intersection of languages, media, and regimes of visibility. The title directly evokes the notion of the "expanded field" formulated by Rosalind Krauss in her seminal essay Sculpture in the Expanded Field (1979), identifying the collapse of traditional categories of sculpture and the emergence of practices operating within an expanded territory. The program welcomes artists whose research challenges stable disciplinary categories, shifting the boundaries between painting, sculpture, photography, performance, video, sound, writing, and other hybrid practices that resist conventional classifications. Artists who wish to use the residency to reinvent their poetics through experimentation with new media and materials are also encouraged to apply. This cycle additionally proposes thinking of the expanded field beyond a strictly linguistic dimension -- articulating it with geographic and symbolic expansion, and investigating how contemporary artistic practices relate to multiple territorialities, questioning notions of belonging, displacement, and borders. 10 artists will be selected. The residency runs from October 5 to November 30, 2026, in downtown Rio de Janeiro, coordinated by curators Thiago Fernandes and João Paulo Ovídio. Each selected artist receives: Studio space in downtown Rio de Janeiro (25 m²), equipped with a work table, in individual or shared format Weekly curatorial guidance with the program's curators Portfolio reviews and critical follow-up on works developed during the residency Conversations with invited curators, artists, and art professionals Studio visits, gallery and institution visits, and engagement with the local art scene Cultural activities in the central region of Rio de Janeiro Institutional promotion through Itinera Arte's communication channels A collective exhibition and open studio at the end of the residency Eligible Locations Global Open to artists internationally. description: As the Integration Analyst , you will be responsible for supporting the Catalyst operations and technology teams in maintaining and evolving the firm’s system integrations and automation infrastructure. Alerting & Escalation: Act as first line of response for integration alerts, triaging issues, communicating status to stakeholders, and escalating where required. API Connectivity: Support the monitoring of REST API connections to external platforms including exchanges, custodians, and data providers. File Transfer Oversight: Monitor FTP/SFTP and managed file transfer pipelines, ensuring scheduled data deliveries execute reliably and completely. IT Office Support: Provide basic IT setup and user support as needed in the office 2. Failure Identification & Resolution Root Cause Analysis: Diagnose failures in API connections, automated pipelines, and data flows, tracing issues to their root cause and documenting findings. Issue Resolution: Resolve integration failures in a timely manner, working with internal technical teams and external counterparties as required. Incident Logging: Maintain accurate records of incidents, resolutions, and workarounds to support knowledge transfer and recurring issue prevention. 3. Process Automation within Azure Automation Contribution: Contribute to the design and implementation of automated workflows within Microsoft Azure, reducing manual touchpoints across investment operations. Azure Services: Work with Azure Logic Apps, Function Apps, and related services to build or maintain integration and automation solutions. Process Identification: Identify operational processes that are candidates for automation and propose practical solutions aligned with existing infrastructure. 4. Technical Documentation Documentation Maintenance: Maintain and expand the technical documentation library for existing integrations, including runbooks, data flow maps, and configuration records. Handover Notes: Keep handover documentation current to ensure continuity across the team and support onboarding of new team members. Standards Compliance: Ensure that documentation standards are applied consistently across all integration workstreams. 5. Collaboration with Internal Teams & Clients Internal Collaboration: Work closely with operations, data, and reporting teams to understand integration requirements and ensure technical solutions meet business needs. Client-Facing Support: Interact directly with clients on technical requests relating to their connections and data feeds, providing clear and responsive communication. Requirements Translation: Translate operational and client requirements into integration specifications that can be implemented or escalated to senior developers. Additional Daily Tasks Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable code in SQL and C#, following team standards for version control and peer review. AI-Assisted Development: Actively use AI development tools — such as GitHub Copilot and Claude — to accelerate problem solving, improve code quality, and reduce resolution time on integration issues. Process Improvement: Continuously identify opportunities to improve integration reliability, reduce manual effort, and improve data quality across the Catalyst platform. Tooling Awareness: Stay current on relevant Azure services, API patterns, and automation tooling — including emerging AI capabilities — to contribute informed input to the team's technical direction. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. 1–3 years of experience in system integration, data engineering, or infrastructure roles. Microsoft Azure — basic to intermediate proficiency, including familiarity with Logic Apps, Function Apps, or equivalent integration services. FTP and corporate file transfer — hands‑on experience configuring and monitoring SFTP or managed file transfer pipelines. SQL and C# — able to write and troubleshoot queries and read or adapt existing code within a .NET/C# codebase; Python is a plus. Fluent English — written and spoken, for direct client interaction and cross‑team communication across a global organization. Experience with AI tools for programming — active use of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Replit, Claude, or similar to support development, accelerate troubleshooting, and improve code quality. THE POSITION Reporting organizationally to the senior Telecom manager, the radio and spectrum manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team, and work in close collaboration with the FIFA Technology team and other key individuals responsible ensuring all the aspects of Private Mobile Radio (PMR) and Spectrum Management Services are implemented according to FIFA requirements for the associated Tournaments/Events. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Spectrum Identify the Spectrum service needs and manage collection of the Spectrum requests from all Stakeholders Work closely with ANATEL to identify and plan all frequencies to be reserved or use by all the client groups during the Tournaments/Events. Manage spectrum governance with the key partners, the main stakeholders and with ANATEL Coordinate the implementation of the frequency plan for all these services requiring temporary frequency allocation, define the frequency provision procedure and the management of requests with ANATEL and structure the organization and management control of radio equipment and monitoring on all tournament sites. Develop with ANATEL a spectrum control process to ensure spectrum is managed during operations Ensure that all necessary infrastructure, services and spaces required for the delivery and support of spectrum services as per FIFA requirements, are understood and effectively communicated into the venue planning process. Plan and coordinate the implementation of the Test & Tag and Incident Management processes. Private Mobile Radio Ensure services are delivered at agreed service levels in line with Tournaments/Events operational support model. Identify needs for PMRs, work closely with Tournaments/Events Venue Management staff to plan the Fleet Map and validate it with all the Functional Areas. Ensure that all necessary infrastructure, services and spaces required for the delivery and support of radio services as per FIFA requirements, are understood and effectively integrated into the venue planning process. Define with all partners the Roles & Responsibilities, and any other operational process. Put in place the means of controlling commitments in terms of service levels, so as to organize problem-solving operations but also to facilitate any discussion with stakeholders. Lead the Request for Purchase process to procure any necessary devices and operational services YOUR PROFILE Education University degree or similar higher education, in Telecommunications, Radio Communications, Spectrum management or related field Experience Experience with Radio and Spectrum Services. Experience coordinating with diverse teams and managing vendor relationships. Strong project management and organizational skills. Detail-oriented and process-driven with the ability to manage competing priorities. Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills. Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred Skills & Competencies Manager with experience in similar projects Good knowledge of TETRA systems, PoC (Push to Talk over Cellular), Fleet Map planning and Spectrum management. Strong Project Management skills, with experience in leading large scale complex projects. Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee. Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English Native or Fluent in Portuguese Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more) Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Marketing Growth Strategy & Analytics (Bangkok-based, relocation provided)
description: About Agoda At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. The team Agoda's Marketing team operates at the intersection of business strategy, data, and execution. We build and scale programs across growth, pricing, and commercial initiatives that drive customer value and sustainable business performance globally. We're analytical, fast‑moving, and deeply cross‑functional — partnering closely with Product, Finance, Corporate Strategy, and Supply to shape Agoda's growth agenda. The opportunity We're looking for experienced Marketing Growth Strategy & Analytics leaders to own high‑impact commercial initiatives from strategy through execution. You'll translate business goals into structured plans, lead cross‑functional programs, and use data and experimentation to unlock growth. This role sits at the center of key decisions — influencing how we grow, price, and operate across markets — with strong visibility to senior leadership. In this role, you'll get to Define and execute strategies within your scope — which may span areas like pricing, channel performance, customer acquisition, retention, or go‑to‑market — translating commercial priorities into testable hypotheses, scalable frameworks, and measurable outcomes. Lead experimentation roadmaps, including A/B tests and other measurement approaches, to evaluate impact and sharpen decision‑making. Analyze large, complex datasets to surface trends, opportunities, and risks; build dashboards and executive‑ready narratives that communicate performance clearly. Model business impact, evaluate trade‑offs, and support planning around P&L, growth, and long‑term value creation. Partner cross‑functionally with Product, Finance, Corporate Strategy, Supply, and senior leadership to drive alignment and execution. Build playbooks and processes that enable repeatability and scale across markets, channels, or partners. Mentor and develop team members while contributing to a high‑performance, test‑and‑learn culture. What We Are Looking For 5+ years of experience in growth, marketing, pricing, strategy, analytics, revenue management, consulting, or related data‑driven roles. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills — comfortable turning ambiguity into clear frameworks and action plans. Hands‑on experience with SQL, Tableau, or similar BI/analytics tools; proven ability to translate data into commercial recommendations. Practical experience with experimentation, measurement, and performance optimization. Strong business acumen: P&L drivers, unit economics, growth levers, and ROI. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior and cross‑functional audiences. High ownership and execution discipline in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Finance, or equivalent practical experience. It's great if you have Experience in a high‑growth digital business (e‑commerce, travel, tech, fintech) or an analytically rigorous environment such as management consulting or internal strategy. Familiarity with statistical analysis, forecasting, machine learning, or hypothesis‑testing frameworks. Experience using Python or R for analysis, modeling, or automation. People management experience — hiring, coaching, and developing teams. Experience with external partners, affiliates, marketplaces, loyalty programs, or B2B/B2B2C channels. MBA or advanced degree (equivalent hands‑on experience equally valued). Why join Agoda Work on high‑impact, global business problems with direct visibility to senior leadership. Shape commercial strategy in an organization that genuinely values analytical rigor, ownership, and experimentation. Build and scale initiatives that influence growth, profitability, and customer experience at a global scale. Principais responsabilidades Atuar como parceiro das lideranças, apoiando gestores na tomada de decisão sobre temas relacionados à gestão de pessoas, performance, desenvolvimento, clima e cultura. Estruturar, revisar e aprimorar continuamente os processos de recrutamento, seleção e integração, acompanhando indicadores e propondo melhorias para aumentar a assertividade das contratações. Eventualmente conduzir os processos seletivos para posições estratégicas e gerenciais, garantindo qualidade técnica, aderência cultural e uma experiência positiva para candidatos e gestores. Liderar iniciativas de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento, identificando necessidades, desenhando soluções e acompanhando a efetividade das ações implementadas. Acompanhar a evolução dos PDIs, apoiando gestores e colaboradores para que os planos saiam do papel e se transformem em desenvolvimento efetivo. Estruturar e evoluir trilhas de desenvolvimento alinhadas às necessidades do negócio, fortalecendo o crescimento interno e a preparação de talentos para novos desafios. Apoiar a construção e evolução das práticas de remuneração, carreira e reconhecimento, contribuindo para critérios mais claros e aderentes à realidade da companhia. Liderar projetos relacionados à cultura organizacional, garantindo que os valores da Guaracamp sejam traduzidos em práticas concretas de gestão e vivenciados no dia a dia. Desenvolver e coordenar ações de comunicação interna que fortaleçam a conexão entre as pessoas, aumentem a clareza das mensagens e promovam engajamento. Estruturar e conduzir pesquisas de clima e engajamento, apoiando as áreas na construção, acompanhamento e implementação dos planos de ação. Realizar o acompanhamento do headcount da organização, monitorando movimentações e apoiando decisões relacionadas à estrutura organizacional. Participar de iniciativas de design organizacional, revisando estruturas, papéis, responsabilidades e fluxos de trabalho para apoiar a evolução do negócio. Conduzir processos de movimentação interna, promoções, transferências, avaliações de período de experiência e desligamentos, assegurando consistência e alinhamento com as diretrizes da companhia. Estruturar e acompanhar indicadores de DHO, transformando dados em diagnósticos, prioridades e recomendações para apoiar a tomada de decisão. Liderar projetos de melhoria contínua da área, simplificando processos, eliminando desperdícios e buscando soluções mais eficientes para o negócio. Principais desafios da posição Estruturar e consolidar processos de DHO em uma empresa em crescimento e em constante transformação. Equilibrar construção e execução, implantando práticas consistentes sem perder velocidade e pragmatismo. Fortalecer a atuação consultiva de Gente & Gestão junto às lideranças. Elevar a qualidade e a assertividade das contratações estratégicas da companhia. Garantir que os ciclos de gente sejam ferramentas reais de desenvolvimento, performance e tomada de decisão. Transformar cultura em prática, fortalecendo comportamentos alinhados aos valores da Guaracamp. Desenvolver soluções aderentes à realidade do negócio, mesmo em cenários com recursos limitados e alta demanda. Utilizar indicadores para antecipar riscos, priorizar ações e apoiar decisões mais assertivas. O perfil que buscamos Mão na massa e com forte senso de dono. Capacidade de construir e implementar, sem depender de estruturas prontas. Visão sistêmica e boa compreensão das necessidades do negócio. Excelente capacidade analítica e orientação para resultados. Organização e habilidade para conduzir múltiplas frentes simultaneamente. Resiliência para atuar em ambientes desafiadores e em constante evolução. Boa comunicação e habilidade para influenciar diferentes públicos e níveis hierárquicos. Capacidade de negociação e condução de conversas difíceis com maturidade e respeito. Iniciativa para identificar oportunidades e transformar ideias em ações concretas. Ética, discrição e responsabilidade no tratamento das informações. As atividades de investigação decorrerão no Centro de Investigação em Ciências da Informação, Tecnologias e Arquitetura, o qual será a instituição de acolhimento dos bolseiros, localizado no Edifício II do Iscte, Avenida das Forças Armadas, Lisboa, podendo parcialmente, e por comum acordo, ser feitos em teletrabalho. A duração da bolsa é de seis (6) meses, podendo ser renovável por mais 6 meses. DESTINATÁRIOS DAS BOLSAS A Bolsa de Investigação destina-se a candidatos inscritos numa instituição de ensino superior portuguesa em curso conferente de grau académico de mestrado. Esta inscrição tem de ser feita até ao momento da contratualização da bolsa. ADMISSIBILIDADE 4.1 Requisitos de Admissibilidade do Candidato Podem Candidatar-se Ao Presente Concurso Cidadãos nacionais ou cidadãos de outros Estados membros da União Europeia; Cidadãos de Estados terceiros; Apátridas; Cidadãos beneficiários do estatuto de refugiado político. 4.2 Requisitos de Admissibilidade da Candidatura É indispensável, sob pena de não admissão ao Concurso, anexar à candidatura os seguintes documentos: Curriculum vitae detalhado do/a candidato/a; Carta de Motivação com indicação do tipo de bolsa a que quer concorrer (limite de 300 palavas); Certificados de Habilitações de licenciatura (em Informática, Ciência de Dados, ou outras áreas relevantes para o projeto); Redigir a candidatura e todos os documentos a ela associados, incluindo as cartas de motivação e recomendação, em língua portuguesa ou em língua inglesa; Dado que o trabalho a realizar envolve programação, o/a candidato/a deve demonstrar ser proficiência em programação, em particular conhecimentos de python. OBJETIVOS E PLANO DE TRABALHO A capacidade de detetar e reconhecer atividades humanas complexas permite a construção de várias aplicações importantes. Os sistemas de vigilância tradicionais em locais públicos como aeroportos, estações de metro e áreas comerciais apenas fornecem informações para serem usadas como mecanismo de segurança. A maioria das soluções existentes registam dados que só são acedidos após um evento anormal ter ocorrido. Ao mesmo tempo, vários setores económicos estão a atravessar processos de transformação, potenciados não só pela evolução tecnológica, mas também pelo aumento das exigências dos consumidores. O setor do retalho é um dos principais setores afetados por estes fenómenos de transformação digital. É neste contexto que surge o projeto ECI4.0 – Espaços Comerciais Inteligentes, que tem como objetivo desenvolver e validar um primeiro protótipo de uma plataforma multimodal de análise inteligente de padrões de comportamento humano em áreas comerciais através da utilização de técnicas de visão por computador, fusão de sensores e aprendizagem automática tendo em vista um avanço no âmbito da aplicação de Ambient Intelligence a espaços comerciais de retalho especializado. Estes espaços podem encontrar-se em grandes superfícies comerciais ou em aeroportos. Determinar o desempenho atual dos sistemas de seguimento de clientes em ambientes multi-câmara; Fazer corresponder a caminhos com etiquetas temporais entre estes, atitudes ou comportamentos do cliente; Determinar a partir das poses atitudes ou comportamentos do cliente; Detetar ações complexas como combinação de ações simples do cliente. Todos os trabalhos seguirão a seguinte sequência de tarefas, fazendo as iterações necessárias: Revisão de literatura Implementação da base experimental Criação e avaliação de modelos Escrita das conclusões do estudo para publicação CRITÉRIOS DE AVALIAÇÃO E BONIFICAÇÕES 6.1 Critérios de Avaliação As Candidaturas Consideradas Admissíveis Serão Pontuadas Numa Escala De 0 a 100 Em Cada Um Dos Seguintes Critérios De Avaliação Critério A – Mérito do candidato, com o peso de 40%: Subcritério A1 – Experiência profissional ou académica alinhada com o tema de investigação, com o peso de 20%. Subcritério A2 – Média de curso, com o peso de 20%. Critério B – Motivação do/a aluno/a para o plano de formação através de carta de motivação, com o peso de 10%. Critério C – Entrevista, com o peso de 50% (só serão entrevistados os 8 melhores candidatos que cumpram todas as condições de admissão, sendo para os restantes a pontuação da entrevista 0 pontos). Classificação Final = (0,40 x A) + (0,10 x B) + (0,50 x C) Para efeitos da decisão sobre a concessão de bolsas, os candidatos serão ordenados de acordo com a média ponderada da classificação obtida em cada um dos 3 (três) critérios, traduzida pela seguinte fórmula. Para efeitos de desempate, a ordenação do/candidatos será efetuada com base nas classificações atribuídas a cada um dos critérios de avaliação pela seguinte ordem de precedência: critério A, critério C, critério B. Não são elegíveis para concessão de bolsa aqueles candidatos cuja candidatura seja avaliada com uma classificação final inferior a 50 (cinquenta) pontos. O júri reserva-se o direito de não conceder a bolsa se nenhum dos candidatos corresponder ao perfil desejado. A presente convocatória poderá ser encerrada até à homologação da lista final dos candidatos, e é válida por 6 (seis) meses para estas Bolsas de Investigação. AVALIAÇÃO O painel de avaliação dos candidatos é constituído pelos seguintes elementos: Doutor Luís Nunes, Professor Associado do Iscte (Presidente júri); Doutora Patrícia Arriaga, Professora Auxiliar com Agregação do Iscte (Vogal efetivo); Doutor Tomás Brandão, Professor Auxiliar do Iscte (Vogal efetivo); O painel de avaliação apreciará as candidaturas de acordo com os critérios de avaliação constantes do presente Aviso de Abertura de Concurso, ponderando os elementos de apreciação. Todos os membros de painel, incluindo o presidente, estabelecem o compromisso de respeitar um conjunto de responsabilidades essenciais ao processo de avaliação, tais como os deveres da imparcialidade, da declaração de quaisquer potenciais situações de conflito de interesses e da confidencialidade. Em todos os momentos do processo de avaliação, a confidencialidade é totalmente protegida e assegurada de modo a garantir a independência de todos os pareceres produzidos. DIVULGAÇÃO DE RESULTADOS Os resultados da avaliação são comunicados via e-mail para o endereço de correio eletrónico utilizado pelo candidato para remessa da candidatura/indicado na candidatura. PRAZOS E PROCEDIMENTOS DE AUDIÊNCIA PRÉVIA, RECLAMAÇÃO E RECURSO Após comunicação da lista provisória dos resultados da avaliação, os candidatos dispõem de um período de 10 dias úteis para, querendo, se pronunciarem em sede de audiência prévia de interessados, nos termos dos artigos 121º e seguintes do Código do Procedimento Administrativo. REQUISITOS DE CONCESSÃO DE BOLSA O contrato de bolsa de investigação é celebrado de acordo com as indicações do programa de financiamento e dos regulamentos aplicáveis nomeadamente do ISCTE e da FCT. Os candidatos apresentar os seguintes documentos no momento de formalização do contrato: Cópia/apresentação do bilhete de identidade/cartão de cidadão/passaporte; Declaração especificando o curso e grau em que o estudante se encontra inscrito. A prova da inscrição tem de ser feita até ao momento de contratualização da bolsa; Declaração de dedicação exclusiva (minuta FCT) com exceções previstas no EBI Artº5; FINANCIAMENTO O pagamento da bolsa terá início após a devolução, pelo/a candidato/a, do contrato de bolsa devidamente assinado, bem como de toda a documentação prevista no Regulamento de Bolsas de Investigação da FCT. COMPONENTES DA BOLSA Ao/à bolseiro/a é atribuído um subsídio mensal de manutenção nos termos da tabela constante do Anexo I do RBI ( sendo o valor EUR 875,98. A bolsa pode ainda incluir outras componentes, nos termos que constam do artigo 18º do RBI e pelos valores previstos no seu Anexo II. Todos os bolseiros beneficiam de um seguro de acidentes pessoais relativamente às atividades de investigação. Todos os bolseiros que não se encontrem abrangidos por qualquer regime de proteção social podem assegurar o exercício do direito à segurança social mediante adesão ao regime do seguro social voluntário, nos termos do Código dos Regimes Contributivos do Sistema Previdencial de Segurança Social, assegurando o Iscte os encargos resultantes das contribuições nos termos e com os limites previstos no artigo 10º do EBI. PAGAMENTO DA BOLSA Os pagamentos devidos ao bolseiro são efetuados através de transferência bancária para a conta por este identificada. INFORMAÇÃO E PUBLICIDADE DO FINANCIAMENTO CONCEDIDO Em todas as atividades de I&D direta ou indiretamente financiadas pela bolsa, nomeadamente, em todas as comunicações, publicações e criações científicas, bem como teses, realizadas com os apoios previstos na bolsa, deve ser expressa a menção de apoio financeiro da entidade financiadora. Para este efeito devem ser inscritos nos documentos referentes a estas ações os elementos gráficos requeridos pela entidade financiadora. A divulgação de resultados da investigação financiada ao abrigo do RBI deve obedecer às normas de acesso aberto de dados, publicações e outros resultados da investigação em vigor na União Europeia. description: Fleet and Bus Service Manager Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION The Fleet and Bus Service Manager will oversee the efficient and effective operation of the tournament fleet and for any ancillary event. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing all aspects of bus services and operations, working close to other Transport workstreams, providing a reliable, on‑time and outstanding service for the established FIFA Client Groups such as PMAs, Referees, Media and Broadcast, FIFA Workforce and Arrivals and Departures. The Fleet and Bus Services and Operations Manager will play a crucial role in optimizing bus performance, developing, and ensuring compliance with Service Level Agreements, Policies and Procedures, the Operational Plan and Reports. This role reports to the Senior Transport Manager. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Act as the primary liaison between the Transport FA and FIFA27 departments for all bus and minibuses related planning and operational matters for FWWC2027 and any ancillary event. Act as the primary operational interface between FIFA Transport and the event bus and minibus suppliers, ensuring full alignment on vehicle specifications, delivery timelines, KPIs, and operational needs. Coordinate the reception, inspection, and acceptance of vehicles (e.g. buses), ensuring all units meet quality and operational readiness criteria before deployment. Manage the return, decommissioning, and handback process of fleet and buses post‑tournament. Act as the primary operational interface with cars, buses and minibuses and drivers’ suppliers ensuring service has been delivered as per contract. Monitor Fleet services performance against agreed KPIs, escalating issues and implementing corrective actions when service levels are not met. Manage all ancillary contracts, if any, and operational processes related to the bus and minibus services, including vehicle washing and cleaning, refueling services, toll management, and the handling of traffic fines. Develop the fleet and bus services Operational plan and well as the Depot Concept of Operations (including the design) and ensure its implementation across all Host Cities. Coordinate with all Host Cities depot locations, space, utilities, and facility requirements to confirm requirements are fully met. Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees relating to all vehicle Operations. Act as the central coordinator for the development of service‑related Policies & Procedures, reports, presentations and Guidelines. Manages day‑to‑day operations pre and during event and subordinate staff including supervisors, coordinators, dispatchers, depot planners, administrative assistants and drivers. Setup of the bus timetables and any required information into Tournament Management System (TMM). Daily management and updates. Ensure all FIFA and Supplier staff are properly trained by developing and maintaining training materials and coordinating the delivery of FIFA‑required modules (e.g TMM, fleet management system), operational workshops and briefings, safety guidelines, and role‑specific instructions. The manager maintains consistent training standards across all Host Cities. It’s also responsible, in coordination with the bus and minibus service providers, for developing and delivering the full training program for all drivers and fleet operational team, including designing training content, defining formats (classroom, online, practical sessions), and establishing clear timelines and schedules. This includes planning how and when training will be delivered across all Host Cities, determining training duration and required number of days, organizing group sessions to cover the entire driver workforce, and ensuring consistent standards and materials. During tournament ensure all job requests are correctly entered, validated, and assigned with the appropriate vehicle and driver. Oversee dispatching procedures, monitor vehicles while in operation, and ensure real‑time coordination with Host Cities for seamless service delivery. Particular attention should be given to PMA services, ensuring precise planning, communication, and execution in alignment with other Host City transport teams. Provide regular reporting to the Transport Senior Manager, FIFA counterparts, and other key stakeholders on coordination progress, issues, and decisions. Facilitate cross‑functional collaboration with other event areas (Security, FIFA Travel, Guest Operations, Media, Broadcast, TSV, etc.) to ensure coherent and efficient engagement with fleet service matters. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management. Strong management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time‑critical project. Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale. Proven experience of managing fleet services and operations projects of a similar size and scale. Experience working with public and private sector partners in a collaborative environment and ability to build strong partnerships. Proven solution‑orientated decision‑making skills. Ability to work under pressure to immovable deadlines. Right to work in Brazil.
